theme_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) merged with The Performance Pro
theme_vibe: Authority, Clarity, Truth, Objective, Functional, High-Density
app_context: Enterprise ERP-lite for Fleet Management (Control de Flota Vehicular)

rules: No generic 'Inter' for headings. Cabinet Grotesk provides a distinct corporate authority.
Use IBM Plex Sans for tables and dense data grids.
Numbers in tables and dashboard widgets MUST use tabular-nums or JetBrains Mono to align properly.

colors.strategy: Functional only. 95% of UI should be monochrome. Color guides action.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton for data-heavy sections. Flat solid surfaces, 1px subtle borders, max 8px (md) border-radius. No massive shadows, just a 1px solid stroke for depth.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data grids to prevent optical refraction of data. Use only for sticky top navs or floating action modals.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Do not leave blank screens. Use structured empty state components with a subtle icon and clear Call to Action (CTA) like 'Agregar Vehículo'.

grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (MODE B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full to match neighboring heights.
grids.table_layout: Full width containers (w-full). Avoid horizontal scrolling if possible by using collapsible rows for extra data, or keep columns concise.

layouts.navigation: Collapsible Left-Sidebar (Sidebar Navigation) for the 8 modules. Do NOT use a horizontal top-bar for primary navigation as the app has many modules. Include user profile/role indicator and logout at the bottom of the sidebar.
layouts.page_header: Sticky header inside the main content area with Page Title, Global Search, and Date/Currency context.
layouts.content_spacing: Dense but readable. Table cells use p-2 or p-3. Dashboard widgets use p-4 or p-6.

modules_schema.name: Dashboard
modules_schema.features: Gasto total por vehículo (Bar chart), Gasto por ciudad (Donut chart), Multas por conductor (Horizontal Bar), Consumo total y promedio km/gal (Line/Area chart).

modules_schema.name: Flota (Vehículos)
modules_schema.features: CRUD table for vehicles (Marca, Modelo, Año, Placa, Estado).

modules_schema.name: Impuestos
modules_schema.features: CRUD table (Tipo, Vehículo, Fecha Pago, Monto).

modules_schema.name: Multas
modules_schema.features: CRUD table (Conductor, Vehículo, Fecha, Motivo, Costo).

modules_schema.name: Mantenimiento
modules_schema.features: CRUD table (Vehículo, Taller, Fecha, Tipo de Mantenimiento, Costo).

role_handling.Admin: Has full access to Add, Edit, Delete (CRUD) actions on all tables. Can manage users.
role_handling.User: Has read access to tables and 'Insert-only' (Add) capabilities. Edit and Delete buttons should be hidden or disabled.

components_rules.tables: Shadcn UI Tables. Implement sticky headers. Implement local search and column filters. Use pagination.
components_rules.forms: Shadcn UI Forms with React Hook Form. Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox, Calendar (Datepicker). NO native HTML inputs.
components_rules.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for Add/Edit forms to keep context without navigating away.
components_rules.charts: Shadcn UI Charts (Recharts). Ensure clear tooltips mapping to USD and es-419 locales (e.g., $1,000.00).
components_rules.buttons: Rectangular or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast focus states.

motion.strategy: Minimalist. Data tools should feel instantly responsive.
motion.interactions: Hover states on table rows (bg-muted/50), subtle translation on buttons. No heavy page transitions.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard. Ensure dark text on light backgrounds and vice-versa.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have visible focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-flota-link', data-testid='add-vehicle-button').

media.icons_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Weight: Regular or Duotone). Perfect for dense enterprise dashboards.

image_urls.description: Rear view of a large tanker truck transporting fuel on a highway. Excellent for the login screen split layout.
Two semi-trucks driving on a highway. Use as a subtle, low-opacity image in empty states or onboarding.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install missing dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts clsx tailwind-merge date-fns
Configure Tailwind spacing to be dense for tables (e.g. p-2) but breathable for layout (gap-6).
Ensure the application layout maps to a robust Sidebar + Main Content view.
Create a mock Auth flow showing 'Admin' vs 'User' views. Mock the data accurately reflecting a Latin American context (e.g., cities like Bogotá, CDMX, Lima, Buenos Aires).
Format all monetary values to USD using Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }).
Data table must include an active search/filter bar at the top right of the table.
All components MUST be created using .js (JavaScript), not .tsx.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Ensure left alignment for tables and forms.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep surfaces flat (Neo-brutalism/Technical look).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Prioritize using Shadcn UI components. For forms, strictly use Shadcn components over raw HTML.
Ensure you add data-testid to every button, input, and critical UI element for testing.
